Rules:

request.user:
Subject: Physics
Question type: integer answer (no options)

Two identical thin converging lenses are kept in contact at a distance 12.5 cm from an object. If real image produced is 4 times enlarged then what is the optical power of each lens in dioptres.

result.working: Object distance u = −12.5 cm. A real image is inverted, so m = v/u = −4, which gives v = +50 cm. Lens formula: 1/F = 1/v − 1/u = 1/50 + 1/12.5 = 5/50 = 1/10 cm⁻¹. So F = 10 cm = 0.1 m, and the combined power is P = 1/0.1 = 10 D. Lenses in contact add their powers, so 2P₁ = 10 D, giving P₁ = 5 D for each lens.
